title: Persist and apply kiosk JPEG quality

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed the exact 0.7/0.75/0.8/0.85/0.9/0.95 allow-list and default 0.85, managed-profile localStorage reload and Chromium restart retention, immutable active Attempt snapshot, and next-Attempt-only application. Fresh focused, syntax, diff, mb-lint and container gates also passed. Source/access-log inspection found no crop, encoding, multipart or server mutation and no scope expansion. Finding-adjudication used behavior/state and boundary/scope focuses; Codex Luna xhigh runtime co-review was unavailable because no delegated-reviewer/subagent launch API was exposed, including the one required retry.

Scheduler closed TASK-062 after fresh T2 /verify PASS; the six-value kiosk JPEG quality profile, persistence and immutable next-Attempt snapshot outcome is complete. No per-task /red-verify is required for T2.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-014 RED: no JPEG quality setting exists; GREEN: configuration/debug UI exposes exactly 0.7/0.75/0.8/0.85/0.9/0.95 with default 0.85, persists one selection in the managed kiosk profile across reload/Chromium restart, snapshots it at Attempt start, and records/applies a change only from the next Attempt; decisive comparison: every value/default/reload/restart/change-during-active fixtures compare profile and emitted next-Attempt seam; artifact: Playwright transcript under .tasks/TASK-062-T2-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Own only the six-value kiosk JPEG quality configuration and next-Attempt snapshot behavior.
success_outcome: The selected allowed quality survives kiosk reload/restart and affects only newly started Attempts.
anti_goals: Do not implement crop geometry/JPEG transformation or multipart serialization.
Do not mutate an active Attempt or server settings.
Do not add free-form numeric quality or more presets.

stop_conditions: A setting change cannot be isolated to the next Attempt.

constraints: Use managed kiosk profile localStorage and installed playwright cli.
Expose exactly the accepted values and default.
Use disposable browser profiles and retain transcript.
invariants: Only accepted quality values are selectable/persisted.
Active Attempt quality snapshot never changes.
Configuration owns no crop or request behavior.
